failures: R7: The contact section has the address (14 Triq il-Merkanti, Valletta) but no phone number, although the brief asked for one. A restaurant without a phone number is a restaurant you cannot call about a table.

artifacts.label: Menu with 12 dishes and allergen lines
Admin list with the stored reservation

notes: One prompt produced a four-page site: home with opening hours, menu with three sections and 12 dishes, a reservation form and an /admin area. The menu is unusually complete for one prompt: every dish has a price in euro, dietary markers (V/VG/GF) and an allergen line. The reservation stored server-side and returned a reference (SPK-B31239); the admin area required creating an account and confirming an email before it listed the booking — a real step a restaurant owner would hit. The only miss is the missing phone number.
